cases.name: Software patent invalidated by a 2018 arXiv paper

verdict.consensus_reasoning: Voided: challenge 1 invalidated the patent first.

citations_matched: "BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers."
"We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers."
"the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference"
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source expressly discloses each claim element in the same arrangement: pre-training a deep bidirectional transformer from unlabeled text using left and right context in all layers, then fine-tuning with one added output layer for question answering or language inference. As a BERT paper with implementation-level teaching, it is enabling for a skilled person.

citations_matched: "QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams"
"A QUIC connection can carry multiple simultaneous streams."
"Streams in QUIC provide a lightweight, ordered byte-stream abstraction"
"The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters. QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [ TLS13 ]"
"Connection migration uses connection identifiers to allow connections to transfer to a new network path."
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source expressly discloses QUIC over UDP, multiple simultaneous ordered byte streams, integration of the TLS 1.3 handshake into QUIC’s handshake, and connection migration using connection identifiers. RFC 9000 is a technical standard with sufficient implementation detail for a skilled person.
